fato_historico: 1942: Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands becomes the first reigning queen to address a joint session of the United States Congress.
energia_do_dia: Today carries the bold energy of a queen speaking her truth before the world. You may feel a powerful urge to lead with authenticity and reach for new heights. Consider this a golden window to stand firm in your convictions, as your voice holds a unique, magnetic authority that can inspire those wandering through the wilderness of their own doubts.
frase_do_dia: True courage is finding the voice to speak your truth to the world.
significado_numero: Represents the structural foundation of your long-term visionary dreams.
conselho: Trust your intuition and step into your leadership role with grace and confidence.
